plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate leveraged ETF exposure. Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet mandate. Add to QQQI and QQQ for income and broad index exposure. Buy XOM as a top-quality long setup for diversification.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, but also limits upside potential.

plan: Trim SOXL and SPAL to small allocations to reduce leveraged ETF exposure. Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet mandate. Buy TZA for inverse exposure to balance the portfolio. Buy AAPL as a quality tech long setup. Add to CRWD, pressing a working quality tech name.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It blends broad index and quality tech with a small amount of leverage, offering a moderate risk-reward profile.

plan: Add to SOXL and SPAL, increasing leveraged ETF exposure. Buy TZA for inverse exposure to balance the portfolio. Add to CRWD, concentrating in a high-scoring tech name. Buy CRM as a high risk/reward long setup.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It leans into leverage and concentration, which significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, especially with leveraged ETFs' daily decay.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure. Add to QQQI, prioritizing income and monthly distributions. Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet mandate. Add to QQQ for broad index stability.
income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income, but distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
